The claim the entry rests on — independent dual ACCEPT 0/0 of v4 — was verified by opening both Stage A files: both are ACCEPT with zero blockers, zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX on subject a542dc6b…, the frozen v4. The constraint unique to this lineage holds: the D-147 closure of NT-3/NT-5 is protected twice on whitespace-normalised text, the rationale states both the D-147 closure and the D-146 measurement, and every non-G23 NT identifier appears only inside the compact negation. Gates 2 and 3 matter more here than elsewhere, since D-147 states they hold for all seven NT classes, and the entry makes no claim about them. The strongest candidate defect was that v4's own clause extends to D-146 and D-147 while this entry's reversibility clause does not; it was weighed against measured convention rather than impression — only D-188 among the ten most recent adopted entries lists any out-of-span decision — and against whether anything is false, which it is not, since the entry both protects the D-147 closure and does not touch either decision. The entry also correctly omits the current-row-join clause every sibling carries, because G23 has no companion row join and asserting one would have been the defect. Three candidates were examined and recorded as observations. At zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX the decision rule yields CONSENT.
